description: The plot illustrates how evaluation perplexity (Eval PPL.) varies with the activated parameters ratio for several model variants, with a baseline Transformer shown for reference. The x-axis is labeled “Activated Parameters Ratio(%)” on a linear scale, spanning from 100 down to 25 (decreasing left to right) with tick labels at 100, 75, 50, and 25. The y-axis is labeled “Eval PPL.” on a linear scale, ranging from about 11.4 up to about 14.3, with visible tick marks at 11.5, 12.0, 12.5, 13.0, 13.5, and 14.0. A red dashed horizontal line labeled “Transformer” stays constant at approximately 11.6 across all x-values. The “Only MoHD FFN” series is a gray solid line with square markers, starting near 11.45 at 100%, remaining around 11.45 at 75%, dipping slightly to about 11.35 at 50%, then rising to about 11.8 at 25%. The “Only MoHD ATTN” series is a dark blue solid line with circular markers, starting near 11.45 at 100%, increasing slightly to about 11.55 at 75%, rising to about 12.25 at 50%, and then increasing further to about 14.25 at 25%. The “MoHD ATTN + MLP” series is a bright blue solid line with x-shaped markers, starting near 11.45 at 100%, increasing to about 11.5 at 75%, rising to about 12.05 at 50%, and reaching about 13.2 at 25%.
